meta.title: Cauê Enrico | Senior Solutions & AI Architect
meta.description: Senior Solutions & AI Architect based in Brazil. I build generative AI platforms, MCP servers and cloud native systems on AWS with Python, Node.js and .NET.

hero.location: Guarujá, Brazil. Remote across time zones.
hero.statement: I build the layer that connects generative AI to the systems, data and permissions of companies already running in production.

about.label: About
about.text: Software engineer with experience in backend development, distributed systems and cloud native solution architecture on AWS.

notes.v: APIs and enterprise integrations with Python, Node.js, TypeScript and .NET, applying event-driven architecture, messaging, automated testing, Terraform, Docker and CI/CD.

AI engineering for the enterprise: intelligent agents, LLM integration, RAG, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, with corporate authentication, authorization, observability and AI governance.
Claude Code every day with Spec-Driven Development (SDD), critically reviewing generated code for security, quality and maintainability.

systems.label: Systems
systems.title: What I
systems.intro: Patterns I design and ship to production. Every company that takes AI seriously runs into the same questions: who can ask, what the agent is allowed to touch, and what it costs.
systems.footnote: System and client names omitted for confidentiality.

items.title: MCP servers with identity
items.body: Enterprise tools and data exposed to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol. Every call carries who asked, goes through OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, and honors the user's role. Questions are logged and become the backlog for the next tools.

items.title: Generative AI platform
items.body: LLMs, agents and RAG on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, wired to the data the company already owns. Langfuse observability tracks runs, tokens and cost per model before the invoice tells the story.

items.title: Data through natural language
items.body: Business teams describe what they want to see and AI builds the interface. Each team works in isolation and reaches data through a governed catalog, MCP or spreadsheets. Serverless, pay per use.
items.tags: Lambda · API Gateway · Cognito · S3 · MCP

items.title: Event-driven integrations
items.body: APIs in .NET 8 and Node.js talking through messaging. Transactional Outbox so the transaction and the event never disagree. SAP integration through Integration Suite, plus regulatory systems.

method.label: Method
method.title: How I
method.intro: AI-assisted development every day, with Claude Code and Spec-Driven Development. AI speeds things up. Accountability stays with me.

steps.title: Specify
steps.body: Contract, boundaries and acceptance criteria before the first line. The spec drives the code, not the other way around.

steps.title: Generate
steps.body: Code is generated from the spec with Claude Code. Architecture, naming and service boundaries are my call.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Every change gets a critical read for security, quality and maintainability. Generated code is a draft until proven otherwise.

steps.title: Validate
steps.body: Automated tests and a CI/CD pipeline. If it does not pass the pipeline, it does not exist.

steps.title: Operate
steps.body: Claude Code with the AWS CLI to investigate and automate infrastructure. Health checks and observability from the first deploy.

items.body: Enterprise generative AI platform, MCP servers and cloud native architectures on AWS. Technical lead for development teams on architecture decisions and AI adoption.
Applications and APIs in .NET 8 with Clean Architecture, event-driven design, Azure DevOps pipelines and support for mission-critical systems in production.
Web apps and APIs with React, Node.js and TypeScript, third-party integrations and OAuth / JWT authentication.
Automated operational calculations and built internal tools for port operations. Technical communication in English with international crews.
Training in leadership, team management and planning.
